name: Locate Animals or Plants

targets.description: the nearest Beast, Plant creature or plant of the named kind within 5 miles

summary: Learn the direction and distance to the nearest Beast, Plant creature or plant of a named kind within 5 miles.
text: Describe or name a particular kind of Beast, Plant creature or nonmagical plant. You learn the direction and distance to the closest one of that kind within 5 miles, if there is one. Casting time: an action, or as a Ritual.
